entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: A school and citadel in northern Terisiare built on the ruined Monastery of Gix to study artifice and magic; destroyed by Lord Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Leader of the Conclave who built the Maze of Ith, was imprisoned in Barl's Cage by Mairsil, and later razed the school.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Ith's jailer who took over leading the Conclave while draining Ith's magic; killed by Ith.

entities.name: Nod
entities.description: Pseudonym of one of the two artificers who founded the Conclave.

entities.name: Duck
entities.description: Pseudonym of one of the two artificers who founded the Conclave.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Urza's grandson who joined the Conclave shortly after its founding.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A mage who, with Sima, freed Ith from his cage.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: A companion of Jodah who helped free Ith.

entities.name: Primate Delphine
entities.description: Leader of the Church of Tal army that attacked the Conclave.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: A figure turned into a Rag Man when Ith retaliated.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: A church that persecuted mages and attacked the Conclave.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: A mage order left without a base after the fall of Terisia City and the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: A rival school in Lat-Nam, which became the only holdout for magic study on Terisiare after the Conclave fell.

entities.name: Maze of Ith
entities.description: A large, half-finished garden maze Ith built around the citadel.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: A cage with watersilver bars used to imprison Ith and drain his magic.

entities.name: Monastery of Gix
entities.description: The ruined monastery on whose site the Conclave was built.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the Conclave stood.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: The attack by the Church of Tal and Ith's retaliation that ended the Conclave.

events.summary: Scattered Third Path mages seek refuge from the Church of Tal after the falls of Terisia City and Lat-Nam, finding it in the City of Shadows and the Conclave.
events.quote: the Third Path was left without a base of operations, its members scattered across Terisiare

events.summary: Nod and Duck found the Conclave on the ruins of the Monastery of Gix, and Jarsyl soon joins.
events.quote: The Conclave was a school that was founded between 69 and 80 AR by " Nod " and " Duck " to study both artifice and magic.

events.summary: Third Path mages swell the Conclave, which is surrounded by the half-finished Maze of Ith under Lord Ith.
events.quote: Years later, the school was surrounded by the half-finished Maze of Ith

events.summary: Mairsil locks Ith in Barl's Cage and takes over leadership of the Conclave while draining Ith's magic.
events.quote: Ith's jailer Mairsil took over the role as the leader of the Conclave

events.summary: The Church of Tal army led by Primate Delphine attacks the citadel while Jodah and Sima free Lord Ith.
events.quote: Jodah and Sima freeing Lord Ith from his cage.

events.summary: The enraged Ith kills Mairsil, turns Barl into a Rag Man, drives the mages away and razes the school.
events.quote: Mairsil was killed, Barl was turned into a Rag Man

relations.note: Led the Conclave as Magus Supreme.
relations.quote: and Lord Ith was its leader - the Magus Supreme .

relations.note: Ith's jailer who drained his magic.
relations.quote: while continuously draining Ith's magics with the watersilver bars of the cage.

relations.note: Took over leadership after jailing Ith.
relations.quote: Ith's jailer Mairsil took over the role as the leader of the Conclave

relations.note: Mairsil was killed when Ith was freed and enraged.
relations.quote: the conclave mages had little defense left against the enraged Lord Ith. Mairsil was killed
Jodah and Sima freeing Lord Ith from his cage.

relations.note: The Church persecuted and attacked the Conclave.
relations.quote: In the end, the Conclave could not evade its persecutors forever.

relations.note: Rival schools with opposed teaching systems.
relations.quote: The Conclave eventually became a rival to the City of Shadows
